entries.question: How to visit first in psychiatry department opd
entries.answer:
To visit the Psychiatry Department OPD at KGMU, please follow these steps:

1.  **Registration (Mandatory):** Online registration is mandatory for all patients. You can book your appointment through the **[Online Registration System (ORS)](https://ors.gov.in)**. Alternatively, you can book via the **ABHA/Health Care App**, or by sending an SMS with "APPOINTMENT [Patient Name]" to **8887019134**.
2.  **On-Site Process:** If you arrive at the hospital, you must visit the registration counter with your **Aadhaar card** and an active mobile number to receive an OTP, which is required to generate your token.
3.  **Fee:** There is a flat fee of **₹50** for the OPD slip, payable through the booking methods mentioned above.
4.  **Timing:** The OPD registration counters close at **1:00 PM sharp** (Monday–Friday) and **12:00 PM** (Saturday). It is strongly recommended to arrive early to avoid long wait times.
5.  **Location:** The Psychiatry Department is located in the **Psychiatry Building** (part of the Shah Mina Road medical belt).
6.  **Referral:** If you are traveling from outside Lucknow, please ensure you carry a valid referral letter for the Psychiatry department.

**Important Note:** I am not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline at **0522-2258880 / 0522-3539333**. Also, please avoid sharing personal details, such as Aadhaar numbers or contact information, in this chat for your safety.

I was created by Dr. Ayush Yadav.

entries.question: मैं अपने पिता जी के मानसिक चिकित्सा के लिए एप्वाइंटमेंट चाहता हूं।
entries.answer:
मानसिक चिकित्सा (Psychiatry) के लिए अपॉइंटमेंट लेने के लिए आप निम्नलिखित तरीकों का उपयोग कर सकते हैं:

1. **ऑनलाइन बुकिंग (सबसे उत्तम):** आप [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in) पर जाकर अपना अपॉइंटमेंट बुक कर सकते हैं। वहां 'Uttar Pradesh' चुनें और फिर अस्पताल की सूची में 'King George's Medical University' का चयन करें।
2. **SMS द्वारा:** आप अपने मोबाइल से "APPOINTMENT [पिताजी का नाम]" लिखकर **8887019134** पर SMS भेज सकते हैं।
3. **फोन द्वारा:** आप **0522-2258880** या **0522-3539333** पर कॉल करके भी जानकारी प्राप्त कर सकते हैं।
4. **वॉक-इन (ऑन-साइट):** आप सीधे KGMU के पंजीकरण काउंटर पर जाकर भी पर्ची बनवा सकते हैं। इसके लिए पिताजी का आधार कार्ड और सक्रिय मोबाइल नंबर साथ रखें।

**महत्वपूर्ण जानकारी:**
* **OPD का समय:** सोमवार से शुक्रवार (सुबह 9:00 से दोपहर 1:00 बजे तक) और शनिवार (सुबह 9:00 से दोपहर 12:00 बजे तक)। रविवार को OPD बंद रहती है।
* **पंजीकरण शुल्क:** ₹50 (सभी माध्यमों के लिए)।
* **स्थान:** आप KGMU के मुख्य अस्पताल (गेट नंबर 2) पर जाकर मनोचिकित्सा विभाग (Psychiatry Department) के बारे में पूछ सकते हैं।

मैं एक AI सहायक हूं और चिकित्सा परामर्श नहीं दे सकता। यदि पिताजी की स्थिति गंभीर है, तो कृपया उन्हें तुरंत KGMU के ट्रॉमा सेंटर (गेट नंबर 14) ले जाएं। साथ ही, अपनी सुरक्षा के लिए चैट में कृपया पिताजी का कोई निजी विवरण (जैसे आधार नंबर या फोन नंबर) साझा न करें।

entries.question: About opd registration
entries.answer:
Online registration is mandatory for OPD at KGMU. You can book your appointment through the following methods:

**1. Online Portal (ORS)**
*   **Website:** [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in)
*   **Process:** Register/Login → Select Uttar Pradesh → Select KGMU → Choose Department, Date & Time → Enter patient details → Pay ₹50 online → Download appointment slip.

**2. Mobile App**
*   Download the **ABHA** or **Health Care App** from the KGMU Play Store.
*   Register with your mobile number and follow the same steps as the ORS portal.

**3. SMS Booking**
*   Send an SMS: **"APPOINTMENT [Patient Name]"** to **8887019134**.

**4. On-Site (Walk-in) Registration**
*   **Requirements:** You must have the patient's **Aadhaar Number** and an active **Mobile Number** to receive the OTP.
*   **Process:** Provide details at the registration counter → Receive OTP → Get physical token → Pay ₹50 at the counter → Collect your physical OPD slip.

**Important Information:**
*   **Fee:** A flat fee of ₹50 is charged for the OPD slip.
*   **Timings:** OPD registration counters are open **Mon–Fri 9:00 AM–1:00 PM** and **Sat 9:00 AM–12:00 PM**. They are closed on Sundays.
*   **Advice:** Pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times.
*   **Outside-city patients:** Please ensure you carry a valid referral letter for your specific department.

*Disclaimer: I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline at 0522-2258880 / 0522-3539333. Also, please avoid sharing personal details like Aadhaar numbers or phone numbers in this chat for your safety.*

entries.question: Procedure for opd registration
entries.answer:
To register for an OPD appointment at KGMU, you can follow any of the methods below. Please note that **online pre-booking is strongly recommended** to avoid long wait times.

### **Method 1: Online Booking (Recommended)**
1.  **Visit the ORS Portal:** Go to [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in).
2.  **Select Location:** Choose "Uttar Pradesh" as the state and "King George's Medical University" as the hospital.
3.  **Appointment:** Click on "New Appointment," select your desired department, and choose an available date and time slot.
4.  **Verification:** Enter the patient's details and mobile number.
5.  **Payment:** Pay the **₹50 fee** online.
6.  **Confirmation:** Download or print your appointment slip to show at the hospital.

### **Method 2: Mobile App**
*   Download the **ABHA** or **Health Care App** from the KGMU Play Store.
*   Register using your mobile number and verify via OTP.
*   Follow the same steps as the ORS portal (State/Hospital selection) to book your slot.

### **Method 3: SMS Booking**
*   Send an SMS in the following format: **"APPOINTMENT [Patient Name]"** to **8887019134**.
*   You will receive a confirmation message.

### **Method 4: Walk-in (On-Site)**
*   **Requirements:** You must bring the patient's **Aadhaar Card** and an **active mobile phone** (to receive an OTP).
*   **Process:** 
    1. Go to the registration counter at the hospital.
    2. Provide the patient's details and mobile number.
    3. Verify the OTP received on your phone.
    4. Pay the **₹50 fee** at the counter.
    5. Collect your physical OPD slip.

---

### **Important Reminders:**
*   **Registration Timings:** Counters are open **Monday–Friday (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM)** and **Saturday (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM)**. They are **closed on Sundays**.
*   **Referrals:** If you are visiting from outside Lucknow, please ensure you carry a valid medical referral for the specific department you are visiting.
*   **Safety Notice:** I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the help desk at **0522-2258880 / 0522-3539333**. For your safety, **please do not share sensitive personal information** (like Aadhaar numbers or phone numbers) in this chat.
